## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? What workflow are you trying to support?

## Proposed solution

How would you like JSONPrism to handle it?

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one fits better.

## Sample data (if applicable)

If your feature involves a specific JSON shape, paste a sample:

```json
{ "example": "input" }
```

And the expected output:

```
expected output here
```

## Scope check

- [ ] This fits the "one JSON → many formats" core mission
- [ ] This can be done client-side (no server required)
- [ ] I have a real use case for this (not just hypothetical)

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, references to similar tools.
